title: Emergency Phrases: English <-> Romanian
summary: Essential two-way emergency communication phrases in English and Romanian.
content: Show this card on your phone screen and point directly to the phrase you need to communicate with emergency responders or local residents. 1. EN: Help! / I need help. | RO: Ajutor! / Am nevoie de ajutor. 2. EN: Please call an ambulance / the police (call 999 or 112). | RO: Vă rog să chemați o ambulanță / poliția (sunați la 999 sau 112). 3. EN: I am hurt / injured. | RO: Sunt rănit(ă) / Am suferit o accidentare. 4. EN: I have a medical condition (diabetic / heart condition). | RO: Am o problemă medicală (diabet / afecțiune cardiacă). 5. EN: Where is the nearest hospital? | RO: Unde este cel mai apropiat spital? 6. EN: I need water / food. | RO: Am nevoie de apă / mâncare. 7. EN: The power is out. | RO: S-a întrerupt curentul electric / Nu avem electricitate. 8. EN: Is the water safe to drink? | RO: Apa este potabilă / sigură de băut? 9. EN: I need my medication urgently. | RO: Am nevoie urgentă de medicamentele mele. 10. EN: Do you speak English / Romanian? | RO: Vorbiți engleză / Vorbiți română? Communication tip: Point directly to the relevant line on screen. Speak slowly, use simple gestures, and confirm understanding with thumbs up or down. Call 999 or 112 for life-threatening emergencies, or 111 for urgent NHS medical advice (verify locally).
